title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2024-7827, located at 4457 South Berryman Avenue, westerly of Barman…
text:
[Council File 26-1631; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2024-7827, located at 4457 South Berryman Avenue, westerly of Barman Street.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2024-7827, located at 4457 South Berryman Avenue, westerly of Barman Street accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: Yoni Karmeli & Sivan Boodero; Surveyor: Brandon M. Hahn
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council would approve the final parcel map for a subdivision at 4457 South Berryman Avenue, west of Barman Street, with its improvement agreement and security documents.
